nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the creator account that receives the whole contract balance in withdraw().
Public address state variable holding the privileged owner account used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Public uint256 state variable bounding valid tokenIds and all loop iterators.
Public uint256 state variable with the minimum ether required to join the contest.
Public uint256 state variable with the ether amount transferred to the winner.
Public uint256 counter of contests, incremented at the end of selectWinner.
Public uint256 state variable recording the block number of the last winner selection.
Public uint256 state variable with the number of blocks that must elapse before a new contest.
Public bool state variable flagging whether the cooling period after a draw is active.
Private mapping tokenId to the address that owns/joined with that token.
Private mapping tokenId to the block number in which it was taken.
Private mapping tokenId to the block timestamp in which it was taken.
Private mapping tokenId to whether it is currently taken.
Constructor setting _owner and _creator to msg.sender.
External payable entry point that sells a tokenId, records block/timestamp data and triggers selectWinner when full.
Internal function that accumulates block/timestamp values to derive a pseudo-random winner and pays _winnerPrice.
Public view returning the number of untaken tokens.
External view returning a comma separated string of available token ids.
Owner-only setter for _coolPeriod.
Owner-only setter for _maxPlayers.
Owner-only setter for _price.
Owner-only setter for _winnerPrice.
External payable function that sends the entire contract balance to _creator; it is not protected by onlyOwner.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to address(0).
Internal pure helper converting a uint256 into its decimal string representation.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, participation and withdrawal authorization.
Miner-influenced timestamp stored per token and used to compute the winner.
External ETH transfer of _winnerPrice to a player controlled address inside selectWinner.
External ETH transfer of the full contract balance to _creator inside withdraw.
Missing access control on withdraw: any account can trigger the balance transfer once the cool period started.
Arithmetic accumulation of _tokenId2block and _tokenId2time values used as the winner seed.
Parameter tokenId of joinContest, validated against _maxPlayers and _tokenId2taken.
Parameter _newVal of setCoolPeriod written into _coolPeriod.
Parameter _newVal of setMaxPlayers written into _maxPlayers.
Parameter _newVal of setPrice written into _price.
Parameter _newVal of setWinnerPrice written into _winnerPrice.
Parameter value of toString, the number being converted.
Local accumulator in selectWinner summing all block numbers and timestamps.
Loop counter iterating from 1 to _maxPlayers in selectWinner.
Local winner token id derived as 1 + (tempVal % _maxPlayers).
Local counter of untaken tokens in availableTokensCount.
Loop counter iterating from 1 to _maxPlayers in availableTokensCount.
Local string being concatenated with available token ids in availableTokens.
Loop counter iterating from 1 to _maxPlayers in availableTokens.
Local copy of value used for digit counting in toString.
Local digit count/index used to build the output buffer in toString.
Local bytes buffer holding the decimal characters in toString.

edges.reason: constructor assigns msg.sender to _owner, establishing the privileged account.
constructor assigns msg.sender to _creator, the address that later receives the whole balance.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against _owner to gate privileged functions.
withdraw() can be invoked by any msg.sender because it has no owner or role check.
any caller-controlled msg.sender can reach the unprotected balance transfer in withdraw.
onlyOwner check on _owner guards setCoolPeriod.
onlyOwner check on _owner guards setMaxPlayers.
onlyOwner check on _owner guards setPrice.
onlyOwner check on _owner guards setWinnerPrice.
onlyOwner check on _owner guards renounceOwnership.
_price is compared with msg.value in joinContest.
_maxPlayers bounds the tokenId validation in joinContest.
_tokenId2taken is read to reject already taken tokens in joinContest.
_coolPeriodStarted decides whether the cool period branch runs in joinContest.
_winnerBlock is read in the cool period check of joinContest.
_coolPeriod is read in the cool period check of joinContest.
block.timestamp is recorded into _tokenId2time and later drives winner selection, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
msg.sender is stored as the owner of the joined tokenId in _tokenId2address.
joinContest sets _tokenId2taken[tokenId] to true.
joinContest calls availableTokensCount() to detect a full contest.
joinContest calls selectWinner() when no token is left, chaining the ether payout.
the join path leads to an external ETH transfer to a winner address chosen from participant input.
selectWinner iterates from 1 to _maxPlayers.
selectWinner reads and resets _tokenId2block values while accumulating tempVal.
selectWinner reads _tokenId2time values while accumulating tempVal.
selectWinner resets _tokenId2taken for every token.
selectWinner reads the winner address from _tokenId2address.
_winnerPrice is the amount transferred to the winner.
selectWinner sets _coolPeriodStarted to true.
selectWinner sets _winnerBlock to block.number.
selectWinner increments _contestId.
block.timestamp values feed tempVal, so the winner token id is predictable and miner-influenceable.
selectWinner performs payable(_tokenId2address[winnerTokenId]).transfer(_winnerPrice) to a caller-controlled address.
withdraw performs payable(_creator).transfer(address(this).balance), an external call moving the full balance.
withdraw requires _coolPeriodStarted to be true before transferring.
withdraw reads _creator as the transfer recipient.
withdraw exposes the unprotected balance-transfer routine to any caller.
tempVal += _tokenId2block[i] and tempVal += _tokenId2time[i] perform unbounded accumulation arithmetic.
availableTokensCount loops from 1 to _maxPlayers.
availableTokensCount reads _tokenId2taken to count untaken tokens.
availableTokens loops from 1 to _maxPlayers.
availableTokens reads _tokenId2taken while building the available list.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
setCoolPeriod writes the supplied value into _coolPeriod.
setMaxPlayers writes the supplied value into _maxPlayers.
setPrice writes the supplied value into _price.
setWinnerPrice writes the supplied value into _winnerPrice.
toString consumes the value parameter while producing the decimal string.
the local tempVal is the accumulator whose summation is the arithmetic unsafe operation.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId only exists as the input of joinContest and should be folded into that core function node.
_newVal is the sole input of setCoolPeriod and merges into the function node.
_newVal is the sole input of setMaxPlayers and merges into the function node.
_newVal is the sole input of setPrice and merges into the function node.
_newVal is the sole input of setWinnerPrice and merges into the function node.
value is only meaningful inside the toString helper and merges into it.
tempVal is the accumulator that directly realizes the arithmetic unsafe operation.
the loop counter has no meaning outside selectWinner and merges into it.
winnerTokenId is a transient computation inside selectWinner and merges into it.
count is a transient accumulator local to availableTokensCount.
the loop counter is local to availableTokensCount and merges into it.
str only holds the concatenation result inside availableTokens.
the loop counter is local to availableTokens and merges into it.
temp is a transient copy of value inside toString.
digits is a transient index used only inside toString.
buffer is the transient output bytes array inside toString.
